checks.name: header-paths
checks.finding: sysbus.h includes hw/core/qdev.h, system/memory.h and qom/object.h. Device now includes current hw/core/irq.h. Header paths were read from exact source, not guessed.

checks.name: memory-callback-signatures
checks.finding: read_with_attrs and write_with_attrs signatures match the device callbacks; valid/impl size and unaligned fields exist. memory_region_init_io owns an IO mapping; no RAM initializer is used.

checks.name: single-mmio-callback
checks.finding: For one mapped MR with the whole access contained in it, memory_access_size does not alignment-split when impl.unaligned=true. With valid/impl min1 max8, widths1/2/4/8 remain intact and access_with_adjusted_size calls the device once. This includes 4-byte requests at base offsets+1/+2/+3 within the selected region.

checks.name: qtest-acknowledgement
checks.finding: Scalar read/write qtest commands discard address_space_read/write MemTxResult and send OK. Exact device diagnostic and unchanged complete state/RAM are the rejection evidence; error read bytes are not identities.

checks.name: reset-phases
checks.finding: enter may reset local state but must not change IRQ lines or guest memory. hold runs after enter phases and permits effects on other objects. Device now clears internal pipe/EE state in enter and updates its IRQ only in hold.

checks.name: qom-getters
checks.finding: ObjectPropertyAccessor signature matches bool/uint callbacks; NULL setters make these properties read-only. String getters must return g_free-owned storage, satisfied by g_strdup/g_malloc. uint64/bool visitor signatures match.

checks.name: qdev-properties
checks.finding: DEFINE_PROP_BOOL has a bool default. device_class_set_props expects a nonempty const array with no legacy terminator; the one-property array meets this contract. Realize callback and const class-data signatures match.

checks.name: sysbus-wiring
checks.finding: One sysbus MMIO and one IRQ are initialized. Board creates one child, realizes it, maps union base and connects output0 to GIC SPI input272. This is wiring preparation, not observed delivery.

checks.name: vmstate-macro-shapes
checks.finding: UINT32/UINT64/UINT8_ARRAY and STRUCT/STRUCT_ARRAY macros match the declared types. C structure padding and local guard.owner pointer are not serialized.

checks.name: vmstate-scalar-byteorder
checks.finding: uint32 load/save use qemu_get_be32s/qemu_put_be32s; uint64 uses be64s; uint8 uses 8s. The declared guard is116 bytes and mutable state is132 bytes, total248 bytes before section framing.

checks.name: nested-guard-before-mutable
checks.finding: vmstate_load_field recursively completes nested vmstate_load_vmsd including post_load before returning to the outer field loop. A failed guard returns before the following EE mask or pipe fields. This is local device ordering, not a whole-machine RAM ordering claim.

checks.name: state-validation-before-irq
checks.finding: The model post_load validates guard and every mutable state invariant before qcb_update_irq. It has no DMA, memory, clock, timer or backend load action.

changes_from001: one rejection call visible to unimp and guest_errors
move reset IRQ update from enter to hold
document pinned crypto-manager no-test branch and fatal-load observation limits
limits: Header/signature/source-order review is not full translation-unit compilation or runtime validation.
The complete QEMU build, compiled qtest/QMP gates and natural CI remain required.
No physical identity/capability/EE state has been measured or bound.
